newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Mohawk CSD, N.Y..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Mohawk CSD, N.Y..

text.p: General Obligation School District (Serial) Bonds, Series

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received and considered by the President of the Board of Education of Mohawk Central School District, Herkimer County, New York at the offices of Hodgson, Russ, Andrews, Woods & Goodyear, LLP, Three City Square, Albany, New York 12207, Attn: A. Joseph Scott, III, until 11:00 A.M., Prevailing Time, on at which time and place the bids will be opened, for th purchase IN FEDERAL FUNDS at not less than par and accrued interest of $9,000,000 School District (Serial) Bonds, Series 1997A (the Bonds''). The Bonds are payable in annual installments which, together with interest thereon, are expected to provide for substantially level or declining annual debt service on the Bonds, as defined and described in paragraph d of Section 21.00 of the New York Local Finance Law, with option of prior redemption as described below, on June 15 in each year as follows:
The Bonds will be dated February 1, 1997 and will bear interest payable semi annually on June 15 and December 15 of each year commencing December 15, 1997.

The Bonds maturing on or before June 15, 2007 are not subject to redemption prior to maturity. The Bonds maturing on and after June 15, 2008 are redeemable at the option of the School District on or after June 15, 2007, as a whole at any time or in part in inverse order of maturity, at redemption prices, expressed as a percentage of par, plus accrued interest to the redemption date, as follows: June 15, 2007 through June 14, 2008-102%; June 15, 2008 through June 14, 2009-101%; and June 15, 2009 and thereafter-100% The Bonds will be initially issued in registered form in the name of Cede &Co., as nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, which will act as securities depository for the Bonds. The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates per annum in multiples of one-eighth or one-hundredth of one per centum (ascending rates with a

maximum difference between the highest and lowest interest rate bid should not exceed 1.50% and only one rate per maturity) specified by the successful bidder. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder offering to purchase the Bonds at such rate or rates of interest as will produce the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in
the full Notice of Sale. A good faith deposit in the a of $180,000 should accompany each bid.

THE SCHOOL DISTRICT RESERVES THE RIGHT TO CHANGE THE TIME AND/OR DATE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS. NOTICE OF ANY SUCH CHANGE SHALL BE PROVIDED NOT LESS THAN 24 HOURS PRIOR TO THE TIME SET FORTH ABOVE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS BY MEANS OF A SUPPLEMENTAL NOTICE OF SALE TO BE TRANSMITTED OVER THE MUNIFACTS WIRE.
The Bonds will be treated as qualified tax exempt obligations'' pursuant to Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.
The School District will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of Hodgson, Russ, Andrews, Woods &Goodyear, LLP, Albany, New York, on or about February 26, 1997.
Requests for copies of the Notice of Sale herein

summarized and the Official Statement relating to the Bonds and such other information as the State Comptroller may prescribe by rule or order may be directed to Hodgson, Russ, Andrews, Wood, Goodyear, LLP, Three City Square, Albany, New York 12207, Attn: A. Joseph Scott, III; Phone (518) 465- 2333:Fax (518) 465-1567.
Mohawk, New York President, Board of Education
